title: Memory
description:
Typed view of a 33-byte memory block.

Used for both stored slots (MEMORY MANUAL, MEMORY 1..=127) and the edit-buffer mirror at `20 00 00 00`. The address is what differentiates; the payload format is the same.

bass.description: Bass tone of the echo (offset 0x0B; min/max at 0x0C..=0x0D).

echo_volume.description: Echo Volume — wet (delayed) signal level (offset 0x08; min/max at 0x09..=0x0A).

intensity.description: Intensity — feedback / number of repeats (offset 0x05; min/max at 0x06..=0x07).

mode.description: Head-combination mode 1..12 (offset 0x01) — which playback heads are active.

repeat_rate.description: Repeat Rate — delay time (offset 0x02; expression-pedal min/max at 0x03..=0x04).

saturation.description: Saturation — tape overdrive amount (offset 0x14; min/max at 0x15..=0x16).

tap_time_ms.description: 0..=2000 ms. Wire format packs this as four 4-bit nibbles, MSB→LSB, at offsets 0x1C..0x1F. Effective ceiling depends on Time Mode (Normal=1000 ms, Long=2000 ms) — not enforced here.

tape.description: Tape age / character (offset 0x00): New or Aged.

time_mode.description: Per-memory delay-time range (offset 0x20). Overrides the System Time Mode for this patch; per-memory wins for the tap-time ceiling.

treble.description: Treble tone of the echo (offset 0x0E; min/max at 0x0F..=0x10).

wow_flutter.description: Wow & Flutter — tape pitch instability (offset 0x17; min/max at 0x18..=0x19).

Mode.description:
12 head-combination modes. Numbered to match the device's UI (Mode 1..12). Wire byte = `mode_number - 1` (0..=11).

The 12 modes select which combination of the 4 tape playback heads is active. From the official reference manual ("Head Combinations for Each Mode"): playback heads 2, 3, 4 have 2x, 3x, 4x the delay time of head 1. Modes 8-12 use head 4, which the original RE-201 didn't have. Mode 12 is the same all-four-heads combination as Mode 8 but with head positions optimized for a denser tail.

oneOf.description: All four heads, dense arrangement (head positions optimized for thicker tail).

RangedParam.description: A value-with-expression-pedal-range parameter (Repeat Rate, Intensity, etc.).

Tape.description: Tape age / character — New (bright) or Aged (worn, darker).

TimeMode.description: Delay-time range: Normal (≤1000 ms) or Long (≤2000 ms).
